description: A personal log of endurance sport, mountains, uncomfortable lessons and the sidequests that make the main quest worth it.
imageAlt: Grid placeholder for the home banner
introText: Follow the challenges, adventures and detours that have shaped me. I share the passions that helped build who I am: the attempts, failures and small decisions as well as the finish lines. I hope these stories encourage you to dig deeper into your own passions and make room for the things you want to experience.
quote: To shape my mind, discover my capabilities and learn as much as possible along the way.
bioIntro: I’m a Swiss master’s student at ETH Zürich, shaped by the southern Alps, a badly planned marathon, and a growing respect for consistent training.
bioOutro: Learning through the attempts, the failures and the small decisions along the way.
